label: OFAC-designated
expectation: Direct sanctions hit at severity 100. The score saturates at 100 under any weighting that leaves sanctions switched on — a confirmed designation is a maximum-risk finding.

label: One hop from a sanctioned address
expectation: On no list itself, and would score clean on lists alone. Received 3 BTC directly from the OFAC address above, so counterparty analysis is the only thing that finds it. This is the enrichment case.

label: Collection wallet
expectation: On no list. Fires the funnel, burst-then-dormant and round-value behavioural rules: many senders, two recipients, drained balance.

label: Pass-through relay
expectation: Rapid-forward: most of what arrives leaves within the hour. Also normal for a custodial hot wallet, hence medium confidence.

label: Self-peeling wallet
expectation: Repeated dominant-output self-change spends. Low confidence on purpose: this is not a classic multi-address peel chain and the rule does not claim to be one.

label: Clean control
expectation: No signals at all. The control that proves the tool can stay quiet — a blank result is a result, and a demo set without one proves nothing about false positives.
